headline: Four straight losses. The slide stops at MetLife, or it doesn't.
lede: The Raiders fell to 3-4 after a 35-21 loss to the Rams, their fourth in a row. The Jets are 2-5, score 19.6 points a game (27th) and will be without Breece Hall.

pick.text: Raiders by seven. New York's offense ranks 27th in scoring and loses its lead back, and Las Vegas still scores 26.1 a game, sixth in the league.

keys.title: Lean on Cousins
keys.text: He leads the NFL with 16 touchdown passes and the offense ranks 5th in passing yards. Against a 2-5 team, a two-score lead should hold.

keys.title: Find any run game
keys.text: The Raiders run for 74.7 yards a game, 31st in the league, and Jeanty had 15 yards on Sunday. Even 100 on the ground keeps the defense off the field.

keys.title: Stop giving up 28
keys.text: Las Vegas allows 28.1 points a game (29th) and 388.7 yards. Without Hall, holding the Jets under their 19.6 average is the whole game.

milestones.name: Brock Bowers
milestones.text: To pass Trey McBride's 221 for the most receptions by a tight end in his first three seasons.

milestones.name: Maxx Crosby
milestones.text: For his eighth straight season with at least 7.0 sacks.

milestones.name: Ashton Jeanty
milestones.text: To pass Marcus Allen's 1,711 for the second-most by a Raider in his first two seasons.
